    <title>std::tuple the Hard Way</title>
    <link href="/2022/07/13/tuples-the-hard-way"/>
    <updated>2022-07-13T00:00:00+00:00</updated>
    <id>/2022/07/13/tuples-the-hard-way</id>
    <content type="html">&lt;p&gt;Let&amp;rsquo;s talk about C++ templates.&lt;p&gt;C++ is famous for relegating important functionality often built into the
language to its standard library&lt;sup id=fnref:1&gt;&lt;a href=#fn:1 class=footnote-ref role=doc-noteref&gt;1&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/sup&gt;. C++11 added a number of very useful
class templates intended to make generic programming easier. By far the most
complicated is &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&amp;lt;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;, which is literally just a tuple.&lt;p&gt;It turns out that implementing &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&amp;lt;&gt;&lt;/code&gt; is complicated.
&lt;a href=https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/main/libcxx/include/tuple&gt;Very, very complicated.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;p&gt;Naively, we think that we can just splat a variadic pack into a struct:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:1&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;values&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button godbolt&#34; href=&#34;https://godbolt.&#34;&gt;godbolt&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:1&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;If you click through to Godbolt, you&amp;rsquo;ll see it doesn&amp;rsquo;t: this feature doesn&amp;rsquo;t
exist in C++&lt;sup id=fnref:2&gt;&lt;a href=#fn:2 class=footnote-ref role=doc-noteref&gt;2&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/sup&gt; (normally, you&amp;rsquo;d do &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&amp;lt;Types...&gt;&lt;/code&gt;, but we
need to write down &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&lt;/code&gt; somehow). The usual approach is to use some kind
of recursive template, which can tend to generate a lot of code.&lt;p&gt;However, C++ does actually have tuples built into the language, as a C++11
feature&amp;mldr; lambdas! As an extra challenge, we&amp;rsquo;re going to try to minimize the
number of templates that the compiler needs to instantiate; &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&lt;/code&gt; is
famously bad about this and can lead to very poor build performance.&lt;p&gt;For our tuple library type, we need to solve the following problems:&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;How do we implement &lt;code&gt;std::tuple()&lt;/code&gt; and &lt;code&gt;std::tuple(args...)&lt;/code&gt;?&lt;li&gt;How do we implement &lt;code&gt;std::apply&lt;/code&gt;?&lt;li&gt;How do we implement &lt;code&gt;std::tuple_element&lt;/code&gt;?&lt;li&gt;How do we implement &lt;code&gt;std::get&lt;/code&gt;?&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;h2 id=the-power-of-&gt;&lt;a href=#the-power-of-&gt;The Power of [](){}&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Alright, let&amp;rsquo;s back up. In C++11, we got &lt;em&gt;lambdas&lt;/em&gt;, which are expressions that
expand to anonymous functions. In C++, lambdas are &lt;em&gt;closures&lt;/em&gt;, meaning that they
capture (&amp;ldquo;close over&amp;rdquo;) their environment.&lt;p&gt;This is a lambda in action:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:2&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=mi&gt;5&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;add&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;+&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;z&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;add&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=mi&gt;8&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;);&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// 13
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:2&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;code&gt;[x]&lt;/code&gt; syntax is the &lt;em&gt;captures&lt;/em&gt;. To represent a lambda, C++ creates an
anonymous, one-time-use class. It has the captures as members (whether they be
references or values) and provides the necessary &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt;. In other words,
this is approximately the desugaring:&lt;div markdown=1 class=code-multicol&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:3&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;MakeFn&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;+&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:3&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:4&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;MakeFn&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;struct&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;_Lambda&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;operator&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;()(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;const&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;+&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;const&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;_Lambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:4&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Note the &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;s in &lt;code&gt;_Lambda&lt;/code&gt;. By default, captured values are stored inline
but marked &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;, and the &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt; member is also &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;. We can remove
that specifier in both location with the &lt;code&gt;mutable&lt;/code&gt; keyword:&lt;div markdown=1 class=code-multicol&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:5&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;MakeFn&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;mutable&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;+&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ^^^^^^^
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:5&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:6&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;MakeFn&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;struct&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;_Lambda&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;operator&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;()(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;+&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;y&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;_Lambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;x&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:6&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Lambdas can capture anything from their scope. In addition to values, they will
capture any types visible from that location. This means that, if constructed in
a function template, the generated class will effectively capture that
template&amp;rsquo;s arguments. Thus:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:7&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;CaptureMany&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;()&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=cm&gt;/*whatever*/&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:7&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;This will create a new anonymous class capturing an arbitrary number of
arguments, depending on the &lt;em&gt;parameters passed to &lt;code&gt;CaptureMany()&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/em&gt;. This will
form the core of our tuple type.&lt;p&gt;Now, let&amp;rsquo;s stick it into a class.&lt;h2 id=lambda-typed-data-members&gt;&lt;a href=#lambda-typed-data-members&gt;Lambda-Typed Data Members&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;We don&amp;rsquo;t want to leak the lambda into the template parameters of our tuple
class, so we need it to be strictly in terms of the class&amp;rsquo;s template parameters.
This is straightforward with &lt;code&gt;decltype&lt;/code&gt;.&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:8&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;private&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{}...))&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:8&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Regardless of what our C++ compiler calls the type, we are able to use it as a
field. However, a problem arises when we try to write down the main &amp;ldquo;in-place&amp;rdquo;
constructor, which consists of the usual forwarding-reference and &lt;code&gt;std::forward&lt;/code&gt;
boilerplate&lt;sup id=fnref:3&gt;&lt;a href=#fn:3 class=footnote-ref role=doc-noteref&gt;3&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/sup&gt;:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:9&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;public&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)...))&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:9&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The initialization for lambda_ doesn&amp;rsquo;t work, because the return type of
&lt;code&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/code&gt; is wrong! The compiler is required to synthesize a new type for
every specialization of &lt;code&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/code&gt;, and so &lt;code&gt;TupleLambda&amp;lt;Types...&gt;()&lt;/code&gt; and
&lt;code&gt;TupleLambda&amp;lt;Args...&gt;&lt;/code&gt; return different types!&lt;h3 id=a-new-kind-of-initialization&gt;&lt;a href=#a-new-kind-of-initialization&gt;A &lt;code&gt;new&lt;/code&gt; Kind of Initialization&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;This requires a major workaround. We&amp;rsquo;d still like to use our lambda, but we need
to give it a type that allows us to construct it before calling the constructors
of &lt;code&gt;Types...&lt;/code&gt;. We can&amp;rsquo;t use &lt;code&gt;Types...&lt;/code&gt;, so we&amp;rsquo;ll do a switcheroo.&lt;p&gt;The following is boilerplate for a type that can hold a &lt;code&gt;T&lt;/code&gt; in it but which can
be constructed before we construct the &lt;code&gt;T&lt;/code&gt;.&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:10&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;T&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;alignas&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;T&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;public&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// Constructor does nothing.
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;()&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;default&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// Constructs a T inside of data_.
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=kt&gt;void&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Init&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;new&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;reinterpret_cast&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;T&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;*&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;data_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;))&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;T&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// Allow dereferencing a StorageFor into a T, like

that there&amp;rsquo;s an imaginary &lt;code&gt;template &amp;lt;typename... Args&gt;&lt;/code&gt; on the &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt;
of the generated class. Because the argument type is &lt;code&gt;Args&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt;, and &lt;code&gt;Args&lt;/code&gt; is
a template parameter of &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;init_args&lt;/code&gt; is a pack of forwarding
references. This is a C++14 feature.&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;Init(std::forward&amp;lt;decltype(init_args)&gt;(init_args))&lt;/code&gt; is a forwarded
constructor argument. Nothing new here.&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;The outer &lt;code&gt;(&amp;lt;expr&gt;, ...)&lt;/code&gt; that the placement-&lt;code&gt;new&lt;/code&gt; is wrapped in is a &lt;em&gt;pack
fold&lt;/em&gt;, which uses an operator to fold a pack of values into one. For
example, &lt;code&gt;(foo + ...)&lt;/code&gt; computes the sum of all elements in a pack. In our
case, we&amp;rsquo;re folding with the comma operator &lt;code&gt;,&lt;/code&gt;. All this does is discard
the elements of the pack (which are all &lt;code&gt;void&lt;/code&gt;, regardless). This is a C++17
feature&lt;sup id=fnref:4&gt;&lt;a href=#fn:4 class=footnote-ref role=doc-noteref&gt;4&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/ol&gt;&lt;p&gt;Taken together, this causes the constructor of each type in &lt;code&gt;Types...&lt;/code&gt; to be run
on the respective &lt;code&gt;StorageFor&amp;lt;T&gt;&lt;/code&gt; captures by the lambda when &lt;code&gt;TupleLambda()&lt;/code&gt;
was originally called. The double-nesting of a function-within-a-function can be
a bit confusing: &lt;code&gt;TupleLambda()&lt;/code&gt; is not what calls &lt;code&gt;T&lt;/code&gt;&amp;rsquo;s constructor!&lt;p&gt;Actually, this won&amp;rsquo;t compile because &lt;code&gt;Init()&lt;/code&gt; is not &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;, but the lambda&amp;rsquo;s
&lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt; is. This is easily fixed by adding the &lt;code&gt;mutable&lt;/code&gt; keyword:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:15&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;private&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;static&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;init_args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;mutable&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...                               ^^^^^^^
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:15&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;We also need to mark the &lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt; parameter as &lt;code&gt;mutable&lt;/code&gt; so that &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;
functions can all it. We&amp;rsquo;ll just need to be careful we don&amp;rsquo;t actually mutate
through it. This is necessary because we cannot (at least until C++23) write to
the captures of a lambda and still be able to call it in &lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt; contexts:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:16&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;private&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;mutable&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{}...))&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{}...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:16&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Now, our constructor looks like this:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:17&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;public&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:17&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;h3 id=more-constructors&gt;&lt;a href=#more-constructors&gt;More Constructors!&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;We have &lt;code&gt;std::tuple(args)&lt;/code&gt; but we still need &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&lt;/code&gt;. But, we&amp;rsquo;ve already
used up our one chance to touch the captures of the lambda&amp;mldr; we can&amp;rsquo;t write
down a lambda that has both a variadic &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt; (many generic arguments) and
a niladic &lt;code&gt;operator()&lt;/code&gt; (no arguments).&lt;p&gt;But we can make it take a lambda itself! In this case, all that our &amp;ldquo;storage
lambda&amp;rdquo; does now is call a callback with a pack of references. Calling
&lt;code&gt;lambda_()&lt;/code&gt; effectively &amp;ldquo;unpacks&amp;rdquo; it:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:18&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;private&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;static&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;TupleLambda&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;callback&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;mutable&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;-&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;callback&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:18&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;code&gt;decltype(auto)&lt;/code&gt; bit simply ensures that if &lt;code&gt;callback&lt;/code&gt; returns a reference,
then so does &lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt;. By default, lambdas return &lt;code&gt;auto&lt;/code&gt;, which will never
deduce a reference (you&amp;rsquo;d need to write &lt;code&gt;auto&amp;&lt;/code&gt;, which conversely cannot deduce
a value). Instead of using &amp;ldquo;&lt;code&gt;auto&lt;/code&gt; deduction&amp;rdquo;, we can use the special
&lt;code&gt;decltype(auto)&lt;/code&gt; type to request &amp;ldquo;&lt;code&gt;decltype&lt;/code&gt; deduction&amp;rdquo;, which &lt;em&gt;can&lt;/em&gt; deduce both
references and non-references. This comes in handy later.&lt;p&gt;Now we can refactor the two constructors to call &lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt; with different lambda
arguments. Our original constructor will pass in the original body of &lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt;,
which calls Init() with &lt;code&gt;args&lt;/code&gt;. The new constructor will simply call &lt;code&gt;Init()&lt;/code&gt;
with no args.&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:19&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;public&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;:&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;([&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Init&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)),&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;});&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;()&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;([]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Init&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(),&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;});&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:23&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;This verifies that we can actually construct a &lt;code&gt;Types&lt;/code&gt; from a &lt;code&gt;Args&lt;/code&gt; (for each

safely placement-&lt;code&gt;new&lt;/code&gt; on &lt;code&gt;nullptr&lt;/code&gt;. All &lt;code&gt;new&lt;/code&gt; expressions produce a pointer
value, and a comma-fold produces the last value in the fold, so the overall
&lt;code&gt;decltype()&lt;/code&gt; is &lt;code&gt;T*&lt;/code&gt;, where &lt;code&gt;T&lt;/code&gt; is the last element of the pack.&lt;p&gt;This &lt;code&gt;decltype()&lt;/code&gt; is the type of a non-type template parameter, which we can
default to &lt;code&gt;nullptr&lt;/code&gt;, so the user never notices it.&lt;p&gt;Ok. We have all of our constructors. The code so far is at this footnote:

&lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt;, this is actually super simple:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:24&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;F&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;lambda_&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;([&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;StorageFor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;-&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;invoke&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;F&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;f&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;),&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;places&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=p&gt;});&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:24&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;(We&amp;rsquo;re possibly returning a reference, so note the &lt;code&gt;decltype(auto)&lt;/code&gt;s.)&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt; is basically a funny &lt;code&gt;std::apply&lt;/code&gt; already, just with the wrong
arguments. The &lt;code&gt;*places&lt;/code&gt; fixes this up. With some repetition, we can write down
&lt;code&gt;const&lt;/code&gt;- and &lt;code&gt;&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt;-qualified overloads. We can even introduce a free function
just like the one in the standard library:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:25&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;F&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;decltype&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;apply&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;F&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;f&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;t&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;t&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;).&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;apply&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;forward&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;F&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;f&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;));&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:25&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The other unpacking operation, &lt;code&gt;std::get&lt;/code&gt;, is trickier. This is usually where
things get really hairy, because we need to get the &lt;code&gt;i&lt;/code&gt;th type out of the
lambda. There are many approaches for doing this, most of which involve
recursive templates. I&amp;rsquo;ll present two approaches that don&amp;rsquo;t use recursive
templates directly, but which can still be a bit slow, built-time-wise.&lt;p&gt;This is the function we need to implement:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:26&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;class&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;get&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;();&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:26&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;h3 id=cheating-with-stdmake-index-sequence&gt;&lt;a href=#cheating-with-stdmake-index-sequence&gt;Cheating with &lt;code&gt;std::make_index_sequence&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;std::make_index_sequence&lt;/code&gt; is a funny type-level function that produces a pack
of integers from &lt;code&gt;0&lt;/code&gt; to &lt;code&gt;i&lt;/code&gt;, given just &lt;code&gt;i&lt;/code&gt;. This is usually fast, since most
compilers will have intrinsics for doing it without needing to instantiate &lt;code&gt;i&lt;/code&gt;
templates. For example, in Clang, this is &lt;code&gt;__make_integer_seq&lt;/code&gt;, which is used by
&lt;a href=https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/main/libcxx/include/__utility/integer_sequence.h&gt;libc++&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;p&gt;Thus, we can turn the problem of implementing &lt;code&gt;get&lt;/code&gt; with a single &lt;code&gt;i&lt;/code&gt; to
implementing &lt;code&gt;get&lt;/code&gt; with a pack:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:27&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;typename&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=k&gt;return&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;GetImpl&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;make_index_sequence&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;i&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{});&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=cm&gt;/* ??? */&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;GetImpl&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;index_sequence&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;less_than_i&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:27&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;We can then use this pack to cook up just the right lambda to grab just the
capture we want out of &lt;code&gt;lambda_&lt;/code&gt;. Specifically, we want a lambda that picks out

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;struct&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nc&gt;Sink&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Sink&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;T&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;amp;&amp;amp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{}&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;      &lt;span class=p&gt;});&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;

Let&amp;rsquo;s see how
well it builds. We&amp;rsquo;re going to compile the following code for &lt;code&gt;n&lt;/code&gt; from 0 to 150
and measure how long it takes.&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:35&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;t&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=cm&gt;/* 0 repeated n times */&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;t&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;get&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=mi&gt;0&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;();&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;// ...
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;t&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;get&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;n&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;();&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:35&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;And here&amp;rsquo;s the results on Clang 11 (what I had on-hand) on my Zen 2 machine:&lt;figure markdown=1&gt;![](/assets/images/tuple-benchmark.png)&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;We seem to beat libstdc++ by a factor of around 2, but libc++ appears to have us
beat. This is because libc++ makes even more aggressive use of Clang&amp;rsquo;s
intrinsics than we did, allowing them to do significantly better. Interestingly,
using the builtin makes us perform &lt;em&gt;worse&lt;/em&gt;. I&amp;rsquo;m actually not sure why this is.&lt;p&gt;But ultimately, this wasn&amp;rsquo;t really about beating libc++: it&amp;rsquo;s about having fun
with C++ templates.&lt;div class=footnotes role=doc-endnotes&gt;&lt;hr&gt;&lt;ol&gt;&lt;li id=fn:1&gt;&lt;p&gt;Arguably, because WG21, the body that standardizes C++, is bad at language
evolution, but that&amp;rsquo;s not why we&amp;rsquo;re here.&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:1 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;li id=fn:2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Circle compiler totally laughs in our faces, though, because it &lt;em&gt;has
this exact syntax&lt;/em&gt;.
&lt;a href=https://github.com/seanbaxter/circle/tree/master/tuple#circle-tuple&gt;https://github.com/seanbaxter/circle/tree/master/tuple#circle-tuple&lt;/a&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:2 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;li id=fn:3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Basically every in-place constructor in C++ looks like this. It takes a
variadic pack as a template parameter, and then takes &lt;code&gt;&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt; if that as its
arguments. &lt;code&gt;Args&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt; here is a &lt;em&gt;forwarding reference&lt;/em&gt;, which means it is &lt;code&gt;T&amp;&lt;/code&gt;
or &lt;code&gt;T&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt; depending on the callsite. This overrides the usual template
deduction rules, and is important for making sure that e.g. &lt;code&gt;std::move&lt;/code&gt;
propagates correctly.&lt;p&gt;We cannot write &lt;code&gt;Types&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt; instead, because that would not be a forwarding
reference. &lt;code&gt;T&amp;&amp;&lt;/code&gt; refers to a forwarding reference argument only on a
function template where &lt;code&gt;T&lt;/code&gt; is a parameter of &lt;em&gt;that function&lt;/em&gt; and not an
enclosing entity.&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:3 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;li id=fn:4&gt;&lt;p&gt;If C++17 is too much to ask, polyfilling isn&amp;rsquo;t too hard. Instead of
&lt;code&gt;(&amp;lt;expr&gt;, ...);&lt;/code&gt;, we can write &lt;code&gt;(void)(int[]){(&amp;lt;expr&gt;, 0)...};&lt;/code&gt;, even if
&lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;expr&gt;&lt;/code&gt; is a void expression. &lt;code&gt;(&amp;lt;expr&gt;, 0)&lt;/code&gt; is still a comma operator call,
which discards the result of &lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;expr&gt;&lt;/code&gt; as before. The pack expands into an
array of integers (a &lt;code&gt;int[]&lt;/code&gt;), which we then discard with &lt;code&gt;(void)&lt;/code&gt;. This
still has the behavior of evaluating &lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;expr&gt;&lt;/code&gt; once for each element of the
pack.&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:4 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;li id=fn:5&gt;&lt;p&gt;A &lt;em&gt;deduction guide&lt;/em&gt; is a special piece of syntax introduced in C++17
intended to aid deducing the types of constructor calls. When we write
&lt;code&gt;std::tuple(a, b, c)&lt;/code&gt;, the template arguments of &lt;code&gt;std::tuple&lt;/code&gt; are deduced.
However, the constructor call may not give sufficient information to
properly deduce them, because we may be calling a constructor template.&lt;p&gt;The syntax looks like this:&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:36&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;template&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;MyType&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;args&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;-&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;MyType&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock-buttons&gt;&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:36&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;This tells the compiler that when it encounters a call to a constructor of
&lt;code&gt;MyTypes&lt;/code&gt; that deduces the given types as its arguments, it should deduce
the type after the &lt;code&gt;-&gt;&lt;/code&gt; for the template arguments of &lt;code&gt;MyType&lt;/code&gt;, which can be
arbitrary template argument expressions.&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:5 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;li id=fn:6&gt;&lt;div class=codeblock id=code:37&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&#34;language-cpp highlight&#34;&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=cp&gt;#include&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=cpf&gt;&amp;lt;new&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=cp&gt;

&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;using&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;type&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;TupleType&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;lt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;Types&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;...&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;i&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;}&lt;/span&gt;  &lt;span class=c1&gt;// namespace std
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=c1&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;&lt;span class=kt&gt;int&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=nf&gt;main&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;()&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;Tuple&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=mi&gt;1&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=mi&gt;2&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;foo&amp;#34;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;bar&amp;#34;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;nullptr&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;};&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;apply&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;([](&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;b&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;)&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;{&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;    &lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;printf&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;%s %s&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=se&gt;\n&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;b&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;);&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=p&gt;});&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=k&gt;auto&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=p&gt;[&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;b&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;c&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;d&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;e&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;]&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=o&gt;=&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;tup&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;;&lt;/span&gt;
&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=line&gt;&lt;span class=cl&gt;  &lt;span class=n&gt;std&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=o&gt;::&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=n&gt;printf&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;%d %d&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=se&gt;\n&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=s&gt;&amp;#34;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;,&lt;/span&gt; &lt;span class=n&gt;b&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=p&gt;);&lt;/span&gt;

&lt;a class=&#34;codeblock-button codeblock-anchor&#34; href=#code:38&gt;C++&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;a href=#fnref:7 class=footnote-backref role=doc-backlink&gt;&amp;#8617;&amp;#xfe0e;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/ol&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</content>
